headline: Leonard Curtis Acquires Parker Andrews to Enter East Anglian Market
summary: Professional services group Leonard Curtis has acquired Norwich-based restructuring and insolvency firm Parker Andrews, establishing its first operational presence in East Anglia, England.
why: M&A activity within professional services expands regional footprints and service capabilities in corporate restructuring.

impacts.name: Professional Services
impacts.why: Acquisition establishes operational presence in East Anglia.
